title: 𝕿𝖍𝖊 𝕽𝖊𝖉𝖑𝖆𝖓𝖉𝖘
physical_identity: Medium-sized island with crimson-stained black ground under a fixed full moon, surrounded by ocean; the Silver Castle on the highest point is the only safe place.
scale_topology: Finite outdoor island plus unexplored ocean; castle with three floors and an attic.
anomalies: castle impenetrable, infinite food and water
you almost always arrive within sight of the castle
lighting_sound: Near-perpetual darkness lit by a fixed full moon; artificial light forbidden outside; castle lit and furnished.

entities.name: Windows, Smilers, Deathmoths, Clumps, Dullers, Hounds, Skin-Stealers, Death Rats, Camo Crawlers
CORAN
entities.behavior: castle-bound; kills other entities, never harms humans

entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: Windows, Smilers, Deathmoths, Clumps, Dullers, Hounds, Skin-Stealers, Death Rats, Camo Crawlers, aquatic entities, CORAN

entrances.method: stay near the Gloom too long
entrances.quote: Stay near the Gloom for too long on Level 9.1 and you will end up here.
arrived through unknown means from Level 14
unknown means from Level 14 and Level 6

signature_mechanic: Run to the Silver Castle through a dark red island of hostile entities without a light or looking around; bang on the door; no escape from the level.
verticality: Castle with three floors and an attic with balcony; island highest point.
do_not: add safe zones outside the castle
conflicts_notes: Exits list is empty by source ('no known way to exit'). Level 6 origin is claimed only here. Written in-universe by Coran's Children; M.E.G. audio log gives CORAN as speaker.

key_quotes.quote: a medium-sized island that every wanderer will no-clip into
one per 35 square feet (3.3 square meters)
There is no day or night cycle.
DO NOT use an artificial light source
There is no known way to exit Level 73.
